artifacts.summary: 4-phase, 2.5-hour plan for the decided scope: cross-repository A1/A1-Gamma/A3 hand-off note, correction of the over-stated deduction-theorem passages in Compression/{Assembly.lean,README.md}, the validated 23-name citation seed block with manifest regeneration under C35, then full gate and scoped commit; no Lean statement changes.

memory_candidates.content: When a repository gates a GENERATED line-number artifact for byte-currency (e.g. scripts/lean-citation-manifest.json under check-module-invariants.sh's C35), plan ordering must put every edit that shifts lines in a file holding a gated declaration BEFORE the regeneration step, never after. Regenerating first and then editing a docstring in the same file leaves the gate red with no code defect, and the only sanctioned repair is re-running the generator -- hand-editing the artifact is exactly what the gate exists to catch. The dependency is invisible in a naive phase order (docs work and manifest work look independent) and only surfaces once you check which files the new gated names resolve into.
